references.text: Moses was commanded to consecrate the people before the Lord's revelation at Sinai, the same command that Joshua receives here
Joshua told the people to consecrate themselves before the Lord would perform miraculous deeds, a parallel to consecration before meeting the enemy
The law of cherem (devoted things) explaining why the devoted things had to be removed from Israel
The prohibition against bringing anything devoted into the house, which Achan broke
The law that nothing of the devoted things shall remain in anyone's hand, so that the Lord's anger may turn away
The warning to stay away from the devoted things, which Achan ignored
The context explaining that Israel had sinned with the devoted things
The Lord's explanation of why Israel could not stand against their enemies
